Paint shop manual · v0.5.0

Paint any part, on any ship, from any mod

Right-click a part and you get a whole paint shop: 55 colors, 5 finishes from matte to chrome, 4 levels of wear and tear, and 61 stickers. One click paints the whole ship, ship brushes do gradients, racing bands, checkers and confetti, and you can turn your own logo into a sticker. Nothing changes until you paint, and "Factory" always puts the original look back.

Paint is pure color settings with no paint textures, so HullWorks barely touches loading time. Parts you never paint are never touched.

Quick start

Your first paint job in 4 steps

  1. Right-click a part

    In the VAB or SPH (or in flight), right-click any part to open its menu.

  2. Open the Paint Shop

    Click the HullWorks Paint Shop heading to unfold it.

  3. Pick pack, color, finish, wear

    Use the ◀ ▶ arrows. The part changes the moment you click. Symmetry parts follow along.

  4. Paint the whole ship

    Happy with it? Press Paint whole ship like this. Every part copies this part's paint.

New in v0.5 · ship brushes

Paint two parts, then let the brush do the rest

HullWorks remembers the last two colors you picked. Pick a color on the nose, then a color on an engine. Then press a brush button in any part's Paint Shop menu and the whole ship gets painted in one click. Finish and wear come along too.

The "Brush colors" line in the menu shows the two colors the brushes will use. Gradient mixes brand-new in-between colors, so they look smooth even with only two picks.

55 colors

The color wall

Five packs. Click any chip to spray it on the paint bay rocket. Neon colors are boosted extra bright, so they pop even on grey parts.

Finish and wear

Shine, then grime

Finish and Wear work with any color, including Factory. Mix them: Chrome with Scorched looks like a ship that flew through a sun.

Finish: how shiny

Metallic and Chrome tint their shine with the paint color, like real metal.

Wear: how beat-up

Wear darkens the paint and dulls the shine. Great for rovers, landers and "this ship has seen things".

61 stickers

The sticker book

Every sticker is a flag image, so it works anywhere KSP lets you pick a flag. Click one for a closer look, or try it on the rocket. In the flag picker they all start with HW_.

BEST · stick it anywhere

CDL-F Flag Decal

  1. Search decal in the parts list (Structural).
  2. Drop it on the hull. It wraps around the curve like a real sticker.
  3. Right-click it and pick an HW_ flag, then size it.

From the Conformal Decals mod. Its CDL-T Text Decal writes your own ship name.

EASY · flag panels

RFP Flag parts

  1. Search flag in the parts list (Utility).
  2. Pick a size: Flat, .625 m up to 3.75 m.
  3. Attach it and choose an HW_ flag in its menu.

Built into KSP. Good for big logos on tanks.

WHOLE SHIP · mission flag

Mission flag

  1. In the VAB, click the flag in the top-left corner.
  2. Pick an HW_ sticker.
  3. It shows on every part that carries the mission flag, and on flags you plant.

Planted a flag on the Mun? Use the Mun landing badge.

New in v0.5 · your own stickers

Put your own logo on anything

Any picture with a transparent background becomes a HullWorks sticker. Then you can size it, spin it to any angle, flip it and stick it anywhere on the hull.

  1. Drop it in the folder

    Save your logo as a PNG with a transparent background in Kerbal Space Program\HullWorks Stickers. The Open my sticker folder button opens it for you.

  2. Import it

    Press Import my stickers in any Paint Shop menu. It also runs every time the game starts. No restart needed.

  3. Add a decal

    Grab a CDL-F Flag Decal (Structural) and drop it on the hull. It wraps around the curve like a real sticker.

  4. Pick your logo

    Right-click the decal and pick HW_My_ plus your file name. HW_My_..._Flip is the mirror copy.

Resize, rotate, flip

Bigger / smallerRight-click the decal and drag Scale. HullWorks raises the limit to 15 m, big enough to wrap a whole tank.
Any anglePress 3 for the rotate tool, or use Q E W S A D. Hold Shift for small steps, or press C to turn angle snap off and spin it freely.
Mirror itPick the _Flip copy. Great for the other side of the ship.
See-throughDrag Opacity for a faded or painted-on look, Edge Wear for a beat-up one.
Wrap deeperDrag Depth (up to 8 m) so a big sticker reaches around a wide hull.
Both sidesTurn on symmetry before you place it to get matching stickers.

Tips for great stickers

  • Transparent PNGs look best. A JPG works, but its background shows as a box.
  • Square or wide logos fit best. Big pictures are shrunk to fit 512 x 320, small ones grow up to 2x.
  • Letters, numbers, spaces and dashes are fine in the file name. "My Cool Logo.png" becomes HW_My_My_Cool_Logo.
  • Changed the picture? Save it over the old file and press Import again.
  • Your stickers also work on flag parts and as the mission flag.
  • Try it right here: the paint bay's Try your own logo button puts your picture on the rocket.

Good to know

How HullWorks plays with your game

Saves are safeYour paint is saved on each part in the craft file and the save. Nothing global changes.
Factory undoes itSet Paint pack, Finish and Wear back to Factory and the part looks brand new.
Symmetry copiesPaint one fin and its symmetry partners match. Alt-copied parts keep their paint.
Works in flightRepaint after a rough landing. Same menu, same buttons.
Every mod's partsStock, ReStock, Bluedog, Near Future, Tundra, Starship Expansion and the rest.
Skipped on purposeParts with their own recolor menu (Textures Unlimited), procedural parts, fairings and wings, flags, and heat shields. They keep their own looks.
Light on loadingA 35 KB plugin and small stickers. No paint textures to load.
Open this guide in the gameEvery Paint Shop menu has an Open Paint Shop guide button. It opens this page, even offline.
Loading screenShows pictures from your Kerbal Brains Mods, plus an 8-second ad for each one you don't have yet. It checks online for new pictures when the game starts.
Stay offlineOpen Kerbal Space Program\KerbalBrainsMods\LoadingReel.cfg and set online = false. It then uses the pictures it already has.
Uninstall anytimeDelete GameData/HullWorks. Ships load fine in factory colors.
Fix it

Something not working?

I don't see "HullWorks Paint Shop" in the right-click menu

Restart KSP fully. Check that GameData/HullWorks/Plugins/HullWorks.dll exists. Some parts never get it on purpose: Textures Unlimited parts, procedural parts, fairings, flags and heat shields.

I picked a color but the part barely changed

Paint tints the part's own colors. Dark parts like engines and black tiles only change a little. Try a Neon color (boosted extra bright), or paint the lighter parts around them.

Where's the Color row?

It only appears after you pick a Paint pack. With the pack on Factory there is nothing to choose.

My stickers aren't in the flag list

Look for names starting with HW_. If none show, check GameData/HullWorks/Flags has the PNG files and restart KSP.

The brush says "paint 2 parts first"

The brushes use the last two colors you picked. Pick a color on the nose, pick a different color on an engine, then press the brush. Picking the same color twice doesn't count as two.

My own sticker isn't in the flag list

Check the file is a PNG or JPG in the "HullWorks Stickers" folder (next to KSP_x64.exe), then press Import my stickers. Look for names starting with HW_My_. KSP.log lines starting with [HullWorks] say what was imported.

How do I stop the loading screen going online?

Open Kerbal Space Program\KerbalBrainsMods\LoadingReel.cfg in Notepad and change online = true to online = false. Save files it already downloaded stay in that folder.

Can I use HullWorks with Simple Repaint?

No need. HullWorks switches itself off if Simple Repaint is installed, so the two never fight over the same part. Remove Simple Repaint to use HullWorks.

I want my own colors

Open GameData/HullWorks/Palette.cfg in Notepad. Each color is a name, a title and three numbers from 0 to 1 for red, green and blue. Save and restart KSP.

Something broke or looks weird

Take a screenshot, note which part and which colors, and send the KSP.log file from your Kerbal Space Program folder. Every report makes the next version better.
